unitTitle: B2 · Work and study decisions: describe relationships precisely
title: Words: core topic language — set 4
subtitle: B2 · Unit 3: B2 · Work and study decisions: describe relationships precisely

steps.exampleFr: La reconnaissance professionnelle valorise les compétences acquises.
steps.exampleEn: Professional recognition values the skills acquired.

steps.exampleFr: Son parcours atypique combine deux domaines.
steps.exampleEn: Her non-traditional career path combines two fields.

steps.exampleFr: Le poste comporte un plafond salarial précis.
steps.exampleEn: The position has a specific salary ceiling.

steps.exampleFr: Le candidat souhaite négocier un contrat à durée déterminée.
steps.exampleEn: The candidate wants to negotiate a fixed-term contract.

steps.exampleFr: Elle vérifie si son expérience la rend admissible à la formation.
steps.exampleEn: She checks whether her experience makes her eligible for the training.

steps.exampleFr: Il préfère ne pas renoncer à ses études pour ce poste.
steps.exampleEn: He prefers not to give up his studies for this position.

steps.explain: une reconnaissance professionnelle means professional recognition.
un parcours atypique means a non-traditional career path.
un plafond salarial means a salary ceiling.
négocier un contrat means to negotiate a contract.
être admissible à means to be eligible for.
renoncer à means to give up; withdraw from.
